intuition: Count each value once, then select the values with the greatest frequencies.

brute_force.approach: Count values and repeatedly scan the remaining counts to select the next most frequent value.

optimal.approach: Bucket values by frequency and scan buckets from highest frequency down until k values are collected. A heap is an alternative with O(n log k) time.

edge_cases: When k equals the number of distinct values, return each distinct value once.
Ties in frequency may be returned in any order.
